title: Literature: the waste vortices' travelling novelty is a physical instance of Heyde & Mahadevan 2026's self-propelled evolution on regenerating landscapes (mean-memory vs distribution-memory explains the bounded standard runs); pair co-division in the digestion ecology has no published protocell analogue I could find
summary: Read Heyde & Mahadevan 2026 (arXiv:2606.15530): populations that deplete a slowly regenerating trait-space landscape self-propel through trait space, with speed ~eps^1/2 up to an optimum, branching and chaotic reversals; this is the mean-field form of c61's long-memory waste vortices, while c58's standard waste stores only a local mean trait, which fits its bounded cloud. Horvath-Toth-Veto 2010 (true self-avoiding walk diffusive in d>=3) predicts the travel slows to sqrt(t) but keeps reaching new ground. Ispolatov-Doebeli 2014 points to many interacting traits for kinds that differ in what they do. For the prey-predator pair co-division: Black-Bourrat-Rainey 2020 ecological scaffolding (UNVERIFIED beyond abstract) frames it; no published host-guest protocell co-division found.
